import signal
import time

def noop(s, f):
    pass

signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, noop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, noop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, noop)
while True:
    time.sleep(0.05)

import socket
try:
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
except Exception as e:
    import sys
    sys.exit(1)
